correctness.rationale: The defined eighteen-arc complex is exhaustively enumerated. Its 686 nonempty cells have 2256 Hasse covers; an explicit 326-pair matching is acyclic by complete topological sort and leaves critical cells 1,5,22,6 in dimensions 0,2,3,4. Both signed integral Morse matrices are identically zero, giving free integral homology. All 33 positive-dimensional critical generators have explicit verified integral cycles; their signed images yield homology action matrices satisfying the twelve-element group relations, whose traces agree with the full simplicial Lefschetz calculation. Separate recursive enumeration and GF2 ranks reproduce the Betti numbers. The theorem does not claim a homotopy wedge.

value.rationale: The triangular prism is a canonical minimal three-regular extension of a bidirected cycle, directly motivated by the 2026 polygon results. Three consecutive nonzero integral homology degrees and a complete rational D3×C2 decomposition constitute substantive new exact topology and symmetry beyond a routine Euler characteristic or parameter substitution. The exact benchmark can support later prism-family conjectures and verification; no general theorem is required for that intrinsic value.
